chunks_used.title: How to verify
chunks_used.text: Ask for the order ID, then ask for **one** of: the last 4 digits of the registered phone number, or the delivery pincode for that order. Compare with the `phone_last4` or `delivery_pincode` fields from order lookup.

chunks_retrieved.title: Items that cannot be returned
chunks_retrieved.text: Grocery and fresh produce, innerwear, lingerie and swimwear, and gift cards or digital codes cannot be returned for change of mind. If such an item arrives damaged, expired, wrong or missing, follow the Damaged, wrong or missing items policy.

chunks_retrieved.title: Resolution
chunks_retrieved.text: After verification the customer gets a free replacement or a full refund, including delivery fees. No reverse pickup fee applies.

chunks_retrieved.title: Reported after 48 hours
chunks_retrieved.text: Reports after 48 hours are handled as a normal return if the item is still within its return window. Otherwise the customer can use the brand or ZentroMart Assured warranty, if any.

chunks_retrieved.title: Condition of returned items
chunks_retrieved.text: Items must be unused, with original tags, packaging, accessories and free gifts. Beauty and personal care products are returnable only if unopened with the seal intact. Electronics must not be physically damaged, and any screen lock or account lock must be removed.
